title: wavCSE retained primary-artifact manifest row
description: Storage metadata for one retained primary artifact. Paper identity and bibliographic metadata stay in catalog.jsonl; this row only manages the stored bytes. The object_key must equal the deterministic derivation from paper_id and role.

paper_id.description: canonical literature card slug; the only artifact identity

role.description: artifact role/version; the extension and media type follow from it. `preprint` and `published` name a concrete version of the work; `source` is the unversioned single-artifact role

sha256.description: content identity of the retained artifact

source_url.description: provenance only; must be one of the paper's catalog source_urls

retained_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the storage act
